author: ClarusC64
description:
What this repo is for
Detect when a drone’s navigation stack is about to fail.
Focus
• GPS quality vs IMU drift
• vision odometry quality
• altimeter stability
• fusion residual as the early warning signal
Why it matters
Most flight failures start as sensor disagreement.
This dataset teaches a model to flag that drift early.

author: ClarusC64
description:
What this repo is for
Detect when an autonomous vessel or submersible is drifting toward navigation failure.
Focus
• GPS or inertial drift
• current vs thrust
• heading stability
• obstacle detection alignment
Why it matters
Marine autonomy fails gradually.
Early drift signals appear before loss of course or collision.
